//: Non-secret settings, reviewed like code. Environment variables override these. Secrets (any *_API_KEY, POSTGRES_PASSWORD) never go here; startup refuses them. Run `npm run config:check` after editing.
// ai: AI_PROVIDER is a profile in config/ai-providers.json (gemini-free, gemini-paid, claude, ...) or mock for the sample data in src/mocks. The profile names the key variable (e.g. GEMINI_API_KEY), which goes in .env locally or the secret store on a server, never here. `npm run dev:mock` forces mock; `npm run dev:ai` uses this value. MOCK_PRICED_AS: whose prices the mock's cost estimate uses.
// llm: Call policy for every provider. LLM_INVALID_RETRIES: extra attempts when an answer is unreadable or the wrong shape (each billed). Models, thinking levels and prices are per provider in config/ai-providers.json. LLM_MAX_RETRY_DELAY_MS caps the wait between retries after a rate limit.
// batching: Spec 5.3b / 5.5: roles (activities) or competencies (ladders) per call, and calls in flight. Calls in flight raised from 3 to 6 on 6 Nov 2026 to cut wall time (the Gemini free profile still runs 1 at a time through maxConcurrent). Rules r3 §6: competencies per review checklist call, calls in flight, most state-fit items kept, and the shortest quote (in words) the code will verify.
// research: Spec 5.2: the research step searches only these government domains for the JD and cites what it retrieved. At most 3 searches (was 5): each adds tens of thousands of input tokens and about 15 s. Applies when the provider profile has webSearch: true; RESEARCH_WEB_SEARCH=false turns search off for every provider.
// postgres: Pool sizing only; the connection (host, user, password) stays in .env or the secret store.
// reports: npm run ai:report / ai:report:daily: the clock days and times are shown in (minutes ahead of UTC; 330 = IST), the billed USD per day above which the report warns (0 = off; estimates do not count), the output folder, and the providers the reports keep by default (comma list; empty = all; --provider all overrides).
// cors: Comma-separated browser origins. Empty: only the uiproxy calls this service.
